wins.text: Worldwide Q3 sales of $24B, up 5.4% operationally despite ~640 bps STELARA headwind; Innovative Medicine grew 5.3% to $15.6B for a second consecutive quarter above $15B
CARVYKTI sales of $524M, up 81.4% YoY and 18.5% sequentially, with 8,500+ patients treated globally; management reaffirmed $5B peak-year sales potential
TREMFYA delivered 40.1% operational sales growth driven by IBD launch; capturing ~50% of new IL-23 UC patient starts in the U.S.; management targets >$10B peak-year sales
Adjusted diluted EPS of $2.80, up 15.7% YoY; full-year adjusted EPS guidance reaffirmed at $10.85 midpoint (8.7% growth), up from $10.60 at start of year

FDA approval received for INLEXZO (bladder cancer drug-releasing system), described as first-of-its-kind with $5B+ peak-year sales potential; RYBREVANT+LAZCLUZE showed statistically significant reduction in risk of death vs. osimertinib in NEJM publication

risks.text: STELARA biosimilar erosion created ~1,070 bps headwind in Innovative Medicine in Q3; STELARA sales declined 42% YoY; further discounting expected in 2026
MedTech adjusted income before tax margin declined from 24.1% to 21%, driven by macroeconomic factors and cost of products sold; China VBP negatively impacted surgery segment

One Big Beautiful Bill Act triggered a $1B onetime remeasurement of deferred tax balances, raising full-year effective tax rate guidance to 17.5%-18%; ongoing tariff and pharmaceutical pricing policy uncertainty (MFN discussions) remain unresolved
Orthopaedics separation (DePuy Synthes spin-off) introduces 18-24 month execution risk, potential stranded costs, and capital structure complexity for both entities
Competitive pressures in MedTech energy segment and ongoing China VBP headwinds partially offset surgery segment growth; energy business cited as a drag on overall surgery growth of 3.3%

guidance_items.detail: Full-year operational sales growth raised by ~$300M to 4.8%-5.3% range, midpoint $93.2B (5.1%); reported sales growth now expected 5.4%-5.9%, midpoint $93.7B
Adjusted diluted EPS reaffirmed at $10.80-$10.90, midpoint $10.85 (8.7% growth); adjusted operational EPS $10.68 (7% growth)
Operating margin improvement of ~300 bps for full year reaffirmed, assuming current tariff environment
Net interest expense guidance improved to $0-$50M from prior guidance, driven by higher cash balances
Full-year effective tax rate raised to 17.5%-18% from prior guidance, due to One Big Beautiful Bill Act enactment

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: MFN (Most Favored Nation) pricing agreements with the administration for new Medicaid launches — not proactively addressed in prepared remarks
Quantification of the one-time reserve adjustment and go-to-market energy change impact on MedTech underlying growth rate
Anti-tau antibody (Alzheimer's) Phase II data timeline and potential accelerated approval pathway — not mentioned in prepared remarks
